agreement_body_intro: In short: Your account will be verified and the necessary basic information will be collected to access our service.
agreement_body_main: This service will use the following information to work with your Discord account and server data:
agreement_item_1: Your Discord user ID, nickname, and avatar information (for account identification).
agreement_item_2: The list of your servers and which servers you are an admin of — to show which servers you can manage.
agreement_item_3: Your server membership status and roles (for permission checks).
agreement_item_4: Server join information — some features may require server access.
agreement_item_5: Your email address — used for account verification, important notifications, and support.
agreement_item_6: Your in-panel transactions, e.g. wallet balance, transactions, and purchase history.
agreement_disclaimer: This data will only be used to provide the service, verify your account, and run the features you request. The scopes requested during Discord OAuth (e.g. identify, email, guilds, guilds.join) will only be used for required operations.
agreement_no_consent: If you do not accept, the login process will not be completed and you will be redirected to the home page.
